links.outcome: Speech-to-text word error rate for High German versus Swiss German dialect, and downstream triage classification accuracy
links.effect: WER 2.3% for High German vs 17.66% for Swiss German; classification accuracy still reached 90-100% for ESI levels and CEDIS codes despite the higher WER.
links.quote: STT models achieved word error rates (WER) of 2.3% for High German and 17.66% for Swiss German.

screen.reason: Proof-of-concept evaluation of an AI-powered triage speech-to-text and LLM pipeline for triage classification, evaluating model performance without comparing deployment practices or safeguards.
